boundaryVerification.note: The GARID satellite map confirms Akweteyman's community boundary and its relationship to Lapaz, Tesano and Achimota Interchange. The published raster has no coordinate grid. The OSM Akweteyman bus-stop landmark is therefore used as the route-proximate section anchor, not misrepresented as a surveyed boundary crossing.

satelliteSpotCheck.observation: The approved route alignment overlays the visible George Walker Bush Highway; sampled OSM building footprints appear outside the carriageway in this tile
limitations: This is a local spot-check, not full-section satellite validation
It does not establish the surveyed Akweteyman community boundary
Imagery acquisition dates vary by source and are not verified here
